verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents syncing to 300+ destinations, with each sync connecting one model to one destination and mapping the model's rows into that destination. Hightouch Events lands data in the warehouse, and it reaches destinations through syncs rather than through direct event routing. Per-destination filtering is not documented. Missing for 10: documented direct event routing to destinations, per-destination event filtering, evidence of per-integration documentation depth, independent hands-on corroboration of the catalog.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can route events to a large catalog of documented destination integrations with per-destination mapping and filtering

citations.quote: Sync to 300\+ destinations in real-time or on a recurring schedule.
Map fields between your source and destination.
A sync connects one model to one destination object, list, or table, and describes how the model's rows map into that destination.
Hightouch Events collects customer behavior from websites, mobile apps, and backend systems, then stores that data in your warehouse.
